svg.text: Range Query Pattern — Segment Tree, BIT & Sparse Table
Pattern Recognition — When to Use
• Array with queries on [l, r] subarrays → range query pattern
• Static array + range min/max: Sparse Table O(n log n) / O(1)
• Mutable array + prefix sum: Fenwick Tree O(n) / O(log n)
• Mutable array + range update + range query: Segment Tree
• Keywords: "range sum", "range min/max", "point update"
• Keywords: "range update", "query after updates", "subarray aggregate"
• Offline vs online: offline → Mo's algorithm; online → seg tree/BIT
Decision Matrix
Operation Structure Complexity
Static range min/max Sparse Table O(1) query
Mutable prefix sum Fenwick Tree O(log n)
Mutable range sum+update Segment Tree O(log n)
Range update + range query Seg Tree+Lazy O(log n)
Offline kth smallest [l,r] Persistent Seg O(log n)
Offline arbitrary queries Mo's Algorithm O((n+q)√n)
Static range sum Prefix Sum Array O(1) query
Classic LeetCode Problems
• 303 Range Sum Query Immutable → prefix sum array
• 307 Range Sum Query Mutable → Fenwick Tree or Segment Tree
• 315 Count of Smaller Numbers After Self → BIT or persistent seg tree
• 493 Reverse Pairs → merge sort or BIT with coord compression
• 699 Falling Squares → segment tree with lazy propagation
• 732 My Calendar III → segment tree with lazy propagation
• 1074 Number of Submatrices That Sum to Target → 2D prefix sum
• 2407 Longest Increasing Subsequence II → segment tree on values
Templates & Edge Cases
• BIT is 1-indexed: always add 1 to 0-indexed input coordinates
• Range query [l,r] on BIT: query(r) - query(l-1)
• Seg tree node range: [node*2, node*2+1] for children (1-indexed)
• Lazy propagation: push-down before accessing children
• Coordinate compression: map large values to [1..n] before BIT/seg
• Mo's algorithm order: sort queries by (block of l, r direction)
• Sparse table: only for idempotent ops (min/max/gcd, NOT sum)
• Overflow: use long/BigInt for large sums over large ranges
Prefix Sum: O(1) static range sum
BIT: O(log n) mutable prefix sum
Seg Tree: O(log n) any range op
Sparse Table: O(1) static RMQ
Persistent Seg: offline kth smallest
